name: M-Audio Keystation Mini 32 MK3
note: Nuvoton NUC120LC1BN, 12 MHz crystal: 32 KB APROM (the app, from 0x0), 4 KB LDROM (the gemifi bootloader), 4 KB data flash at 0x1F000 (the config journal; its last page holds the device ID), 4 KB SRAM with the mailbox in its top 16 bytes. The buttons, LEDs and the bootloader's entry combo (Pitch down + Pitch up) are in the board header (keystation-mini32-mk3.h).
